correctness.rationale: At each even conditioned R=2t, both color cut sets are independent uniform (t-1)-subsets. A uniformly chosen available cut gives exactly the two odd orientation weights (a-t)/(a+b-2t) and (b-t)/(a+b-2t). The odd-to-even cut of the lagging color produces uniform t-subsets independent of which orientation preceded it. Induction gives all marginals; single-part splitting proves pathwise majorization and a strict Q reduction >=2. A separate generating-function identity yields E[sum X_i^2]=x(2x-t+1)/(t+1). Full word enumeration and independent exact cut-kernel enumeration passed for all 49 pairs a,b<=7.

originality.rationale: The structural all-level refinement/majorization coupling for fixed-content binary run-length vectors is distinct from earlier explicit counts and longest-run distribution tables. Kazemi–Jafari provides composition counts, Wentzel-Larsen–Anhøj a joint C/L distribution, and Kong marginal ordered-run length formulas. Exact distributional coverage alone does not establish an almost-sure nested coupling of entire length vectors or the simultaneous convex-order conclusions. Broad inaccessible earlier papers remain a priority risk.
residual_risks: Lou (1996) full text could not be inspected despite arXiv/open-access and authorized institution attempts; its abstract alone cannot exclude an unstated structural ordering.
Kong (2006) full text was inaccessible; later related accessible work is not proof that 2006 lacked an equivalent refinement.

Exact distribution formulae from prior work could yield the maximal-run stochastic order by an additional argument; the claim of originality rests on the stronger simultaneous pathwise majorization and convex-family comparison, not on uniqueness of each marginal tail value.
No independent historical-priority audit has been performed.

value.rationale: The fixed-margin nonparametric runs-count and longest-run tests have a substantive joint-calibration gap: individual joint probabilities do not give a structural comparison valid at every conditioning level. The new coupling orders the entire composition by majorization, hence all convex dispersion functionals and the two longest-run statistics simultaneously, and supplies a sharp at-least-two one-step improvement in the quadratic clustering statistic with exact finite-sample expectation formulas. It is not a parameter-renaming or an arbitrary finite slice.
